properties.name: stx.graphix.enabled
properties.description: Serve GraphQL at stx.graphix.path. Off unless set: putting this library on the classpath must not open an endpoint.

properties.name: stx.graphix.path
properties.description: HTTP path for POST and GET. Default /graphql.

properties.name: stx.graphix.subscriptions
properties.description: How subscriptions are served: sse (text/event-stream on POST) or graphql-ws (WebSocket on the same path).

properties.name: stx.graphix.schema-locations
properties.description: Directories of GraphQL schema documents. Default classpath:graphql/, scanned recursively. Several files merge.

properties.name: stx.graphix.introspection
properties.description: Whether __schema and __type answer. On by default — GraphiQL and Apollo Sandbox need them.

properties.name: stx.graphix.sandbox
properties.description: Serve an Apollo Sandbox page at sandbox-path. Off by default: enabling GraphQL must not also open an HTML page that advertises the schema.

properties.name: stx.graphix.sandbox-path
properties.description: Where the Apollo Sandbox page is served. Default /sandbox, a sibling of path.

properties.name: stx.graphix.sandbox-endpoint
properties.description: GraphQL URL the sandbox opens with. Empty — the default — resolves it in the browser from the page's own origin and path, which survives a proxy, https and a republished port.

properties.name: stx.graphix.schema-file-extensions
properties.description: File suffixes scanned under schema-locations. Default .graphqls and .gqls.
